question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Baffle
solution:
The correct answer is '**Confuse**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym**** **of the given word '**Baffle**' is '**Confuse**'.
 
• **Baffle**: to be impossible to understand; to confuse somebody very much. (चकरा देना; उलझन में डाल देना)
 
 
• *Example: His illness **baffled** the doctors.*
 
 
 
• **Confuse**: to make somebody unable to think clearly or to know what to do. (उलझन में डाल देना; गड़बड़ा या चकरा देना; सोच-विचार में दुविधा पैदा करना)
 
 
• *Example: He **confused** everybody with his pages of facts and figures.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Confuse.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Perceive**: to notice or realize something. (इंद्रियों द्वारा ग्रहण करना, देखना, जानना, बोध होना)
 
• **Betray**: to give information about somebody/something to an enemy; to make a secret known. (शत्रु को गोपनीय मामलों की जानकारी देना; रहस्‍य उजागर करना)
 
• **Convince**: to succeed in making somebody believe something. (किसी को विश्‍वास दिलाना; आश्‍वस्‍त करना)
